notes: required_tools lists only what the current pipeline (extract via `xorriso -osirrox on`, rebuild via `xorriso -as mkisofs`) actually invokes - see docs/distribution/iso-build.md. squashfs-tools/mtools/dosfstools are NOT required because S7.0 does not modify the SquashFS live filesystem or any FAT/EFI partition contents; it only extracts the ISO9660 tree, applies the allowlisted overlay, and rebuilds with xorriso, preserving the base image's own live-filesystem and EFI partition bytes unchanged (Sections 34-36). rsync/jq are not required either - see docs/distribution/known-limitations.md for why the Section 19 tool list was trimmed rather than blanket-required.
